summary: Westravelle proposal WA/2020/313 (November 2020) to Corvenlea Pharmaceuticals plc (formerly Corvenlea Ltd) for a twelve-month ICH stability study on CVL tablet lot 3, with qualification of the assay and related-substances HPLC method. Fixed price £53,000; pull schedule at 0, 1, 3, 6, 9 and 12 months.

title_block.title: PROPOSAL: ICH STABILITY STUDY AND METHOD QUALIFICATION
title_block.subtitle: CVL tablets, lot 3
lines: Client: Corvenlea Pharmaceuticals plc (formerly Corvenlea Ltd)
Prepared by: Dr A. Penrose, Head of Analytical Services

blocks.p: 1.1 Corvenlea Pharmaceuticals plc has asked Westravelle Analytical to place one lot of CVL immediate-release tablets on an ICH stability programme and to qualify the assay and related-substances HPLC method used for the pulls.

1.2 Client records transferred from Corvenlea Ltd are referenced under the current company name. Prior work for the client within the group (DMPK, 2016) was carried out by Merrivoss Bioanalysis under the name Corvenlea Ltd.

list: 2.1 Stability lot: CVL tablets, lot 3, packed in HDPE bottles with induction seal and desiccant
2.2 Quantity required: 420 tablets per condition plus 10% contingency
2.3 Reference standard and impurity markers supplied by the client with certificates of analysis

blocks.p: 3.1 Chambers are mapped annually and monitored continuously; excursions are handled under SOP WA-SOP-018 and reported as deviation notes.

3.2 Dissolution testing is run by Corvenlea Pharmaceuticals plc at its own laboratory on tablets supplied from the same pulls; it is outside this proposal. One-lot data support the client's formulation transfer package, not a shelf-life claim.

4.1 Before the 0-month pull the client's HPLC method will be qualified for specificity, linearity, accuracy, repeatability, intermediate precision and LOQ for the two specified impurities (RRT 0.86 and RRT 1.12).

4.2 Forced degradation (acid, base, oxidation, heat and light) will be used to show that the assay and related-substances method is stability-indicating before the 0-month pull; system suitability is run with every sequence.
4.3 Results outside the system suitability limits invalidate the sequence.

list: 5.1 Data summary after each pull (sequence sheets and trend tables)
5.3 Final report at 12 months with trend plots against specification

blocks.p: 6.1 Prices exclude VAT. 30% invoiced at study start, 40% at the 6-month interim report and 30% on the final report.
7.1 This proposal is valid for 60 days. Work starts on receipt of a purchase order and the stability lot.
